senses.example: El chupinazo abre las fiestas el seis de julio.
senses.exampleGloss: The chupinazo opens the festival on the sixth of July.

alternatives.reason: The physical rocket, not the ceremony that starts the festival.
A later event of the same festival; already in the corpus.

notes: City-specific to Pamplona: fired from the town hall balcony at noon on 6 July.
